summary: Ubuntu 11.04 (Natty Narwhal) introduced the Unity desktop, replacing GNOME Shell as the default. Unity moved the window controls to the left, added a launcher bar and global menu integration. Banshee replaced Rhythmbox. LibreOffice replaced OpenOffice.org. The change from GNOME 2 to Unity was polarizing—many users switched to Xubuntu or Lubuntu or forked MATE/GNOME.
notes: Unsupported since 2012-10-28. Kernel 2.6.38. Unity was controversial but eventually became Ubuntu's identity until it was replaced by GNOME in 17.10.
